equipment: no reset button on this board
environment: RC receiver part of the unpowered VTX, so no RC link

observations: Every run printed ELF SHA-256 cd873d6b..., the release ELF preserved by the BUILD-FOX-001 record for this candidate.

Four boots reached the same steady state: PLL48 valid at 48 MHz, SPI2 flash ef:40:18 16 MiB supported, ICM42688-P WHO_AM_I 71, flash recovered at page 0 with config seq 25, telemetry-qualified DShot arming on PA10.
Every DShot report in all four runs was [0, 0, 0, 0] with expired 0, timeouts 0 and faults 0; no arming and no panic occurred.
The two-second heartbeat continued to the end of each capture.
One boot-time `IMU stale in control loop: seq 0, stale ticks 1` per run, before the first IMU sample.
ESC telemetry latched faulted after M1's response timeout in each run, correct with no ESC power.
Each run ended on the probe's SwdDpError as USB was unplugged, so terminal_embed exited nonzero; that is the SWD session dropping, not firmware behaviour.
First boot-idle run on FerroForge 0.4 with u64 internal timestamps.
limitations: No oscilloscope or logic analyzer: no motor output pulse before the actuator-output task initializes was not observed electrically. Actuator power was disconnected throughout, so no pulse could reach a motor; direct observation is deferred to the powered props-off gate.
Motor outputs at stop are evidenced by the firmware's own DShot reports, not by measurement at the pins.
Each captured boot is the reset after probe-rs programs the image; the cold USB power cycles between runs were not captured. No brownout was induced and NRST was not asserted.
The procedure's LED heartbeat check does not apply to this board (onboard_debug_leds_usable_with_swd is false); the RTT heartbeat was used instead.
The operator reported completion without separate observations; no heat or abnormal behaviour was reported.
